figma.description: Figma MCP — generate diagrams (FigJam), write to canvas, extract design context, generate code from designs. Skill: figma-generate-diagram.

perplexity.description: Real-time web search, reasoning, and deep research via Perplexity Sonar models. Tools: perplexity_search, perplexity_ask, perplexity_research, perplexity_reason.

notion-workspace.description: Notion workspace MCP (local fork with extended block types: headings, annotations, image support).

github.description: Use this server for GitHub operations: read repositories, browse code, search files, manage issues and pull requests, monitor GitHub Actions workflows, and access user/org information.

remote.aws-knowledge.description: Remote AWS official documentation and knowledge server. Use this for AWS service documentation, best practices, Well-Architected Framework guidance, pricing, limits, quotas, and how-to questions about any AWS service.

markitdown.description: Convert any document to Markdown for reading. Supports Word (.docx), Excel (.xlsx/.xls), PDF, PowerPoint (.pptx), HTML, images, and more. Use convert_to_markdown with a file:// URI to extract document contents as Markdown.

airtable.description: Airtable database MCP server. Use this to create, read, update, and delete records in Airtable bases. Provides a visual web interface (kanban, grid, calendar) for data that the agent pushes. Bidirectional: agent writes data, user interacts visually, agent reads back changes.

alithya-knowledge-rag.description: Personal knowledge base (remote RAG server on PC Alithya). Use this for ALL personal/private information: personal documents, notes, private files, financial records, procedures, and any data stored in Dropbox/AAA_PRIVATE_LIFE. Supports PDF, Markdown, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and code files. Use search_knowledge for queries.

firecrawl.description: Web scraping, crawling, and search MCP server. Use this to scrape single pages, crawl entire sites, search the web, map site URLs, extract structured data from web pages, and perform autonomous web research. Supports JSON extraction with schemas, batch scraping, and interactive page navigation. Ideal for parsing municipal sites, extracting registration info, dates, locations from complex web pages.

gmail.description: Gmail and Google Calendar MCP server. Use this to search emails, read messages, create drafts, reply to emails, manage labels, and access Google Calendar events. Supports multiple Google accounts.

mcp-mermaid.description: Mermaid diagram generator. Converts Mermaid markdown syntax to PNG/SVG images. Use this to generate flowcharts, sequence diagrams, Gantt charts, ER diagrams, state diagrams, class diagrams, pie charts, and more from text descriptions.

notebooklm.description: Google NotebookLM MCP server. Use this to manage NotebookLM notebooks: list, create, delete notebooks; add sources (URLs, text, Google Drive, YouTube); query notebooks with AI for analysis and summaries; generate content (audio podcasts, videos, slides, infographics, mind maps, flashcards); download artifacts; share notebooks; sync Drive sources; batch operations; cross-notebook queries; and web/Drive research with automatic source import.

telegram.description: Telegram messaging MCP server (userbot via MTProto). Use this for ANY question about Telegram messages, conversations, or contacts. Supports: searching messages in specific chats or globally, sending/editing/deleting messages, reading chat history, managing contacts, reactions, and media. Use for searching conversations with spouse, personal notes channel, or sending messages.

ticktick.description: TickTick task management (read+write). Use this to manage personal tasks, projects, habits, tags, focus stats, and kanban boards. Supports: create/update/complete/delete tasks, list projects, query tasks by date/priority/tag, manage habits and check-ins, get focus stats, batch operations, and saved query presets.

whatsapp.description: WhatsApp messaging integration. Search messages, read conversations, send messages via WhatsApp. Use for family communications and retrieving WhatsApp conversation history.

mural.description: MURAL collaboration tool. Use this whenever the user mentions 'mural', 'MURAL', a mural board, or visual collaboration content. Default mural: PERSONAL (ID: f6a392091666d7eb480abe141fe326f5e6b96c54). Supports: listing workspaces/rooms/murals, reading all content from a mural (sticky notes, shapes, text, images), searching text inside murals, creating/updating/deleting sticky notes, and creating new murals.

mcp-image-recognition.description: Image analysis MCP Server (READ-ONLY). Analyzes images (diagrams, screenshots, documents) using Amazon Bedrock vision models (Nova Pro, Claude) via the local Bedrock Access Gateway. Requires the gateway running on localhost:8766. Do NOT use for modifying or generating images.

ssh-mcp-server.description: SSH remote server management via ~/.ssh/config host aliases. Use this to execute commands on remote hosts, upload/download files, and list configured SSH servers. Supports bastion hosts, SOCKS proxy, 2FA, and multi-connection configs.

napkin-ai.description: Generate professional infographics and visuals (mindmaps, flowcharts, timelines, comparisons) from text using Napkin AI. Use when user asks for visual diagrams, infographics, or visual representations of concepts.

excalidraw-mcp.description: Generate hand-drawn style diagrams (flowcharts, mindmaps, architecture, sequence, ER, class, state, timeline, kanban, wireframes, org charts) as .excalidraw files with Sugiyama auto-layout. Use when user asks for technical diagrams or visual representations of systems and processes.

rtl-visual-mcp.description: Generate PNG visuals with proper RTL Arabic/English bidirectional text rendering. Use when user asks for a visual Tunisian explanation or any diagram containing Arabic text mixed with English technical terms.

linkedin-mcp.description: Access LinkedIn data: profiles, job search, company info, messages, feed, saved posts, people search. Use when user asks about LinkedIn profiles, jobs, companies, or networking.

bitbucket-mcp.description: Atlassian Bitbucket MCP. Manage repos, pull requests, pipelines, branches, and files on Bitbucket Cloud. Use when user asks about Bitbucket repositories or CI/CD pipelines.

google-maps.description: Google Maps Grounding Lite — search places (restaurants, clinics, schools), compute routes (driving/walking), and lookup weather for any location. Use when user asks about nearby places, directions, or location-based queries.
